title: Oak Grove Cemetery Expansion
summary: A schematic design for a 2.3-acre expansion of Lexington's historic cemetery, with green burial sites, a park setting and a non-denominational sanctuary.
reviewNote: Existing text from the current site. That page uses the cemetery's former name, Stonewall Jackson Cemetery; City Council renamed it Oak Grove Cemetery in September 2020, and the firm should confirm the title. The client, the year and the four-part story are still to come.
description: Schematic design for 2.3 acre expansion to Lexington's historic Oak Grove Cemetery providing not only green burial sites but also a passive recreational park setting and non-denominational sanctuary. 3D graphics by Amanda R. Merchant.
